# Cappuccino Bag

Cappuccino Bag is the B2B OEM/ODM brand of Guangzhou Cappuccino Leather Handbag Co., Ltd. It supports development of bags and carrying accessories for racket sports, outdoor use and travel.

Public inquiry email: info@cappuccinobag.net
Public WhatsApp: +86 139 2871 5568

## Connected OEM/ODM solutions
- [Racket Sports OEM/ODM](https://www.cappuccinobag.com/oem-odm-bag-manufacturer#racket-sports): Padel-first bag and soft-goods sourcing; existing sport pages retain product intent.
- [Brand Product Development](https://www.cappuccinobag.com/oem-odm-bag-manufacturer#brand-development): Discovery, materials, design approval, sampling, revision, bulk production and QC.
- [Clubs & Events Solutions](https://www.cappuccinobag.com/oem-odm-bag-manufacturer#clubs-events): Team bags, event gift sets, racket covers, accessories and packaging; manufacturing and supplier coordination, not event operation.

## Custom production and order terms
At least 300 pieces per style for new custom bulk orders, not per colour. Different styles cannot be combined. Colour splits and material, hardware and packaging minimums require separate review and may increase the quantity. Sample development and any fee are assessed separately after design approval. Existing agreed orders keep their agreed terms; exceptions require explicit approval. This custom-production policy is not a stock or wholesale offer. Historical catalogue quantities do not confirm current stock availability or current custom-order terms. For any stock or wholesale enquiry, availability and order terms require separate confirmation. An RFQ does not authorize sampling or charges. Specifications, materials, lead times, pricing and compliance documentation require project-specific confirmation. Read product imagery with its visible concept or sample status.

## Commercial and content interpretation
Custom MOQ is 300 pcs per style; special proposals require manual review. Design approval precedes separately authorized physical sampling and any sample fee. An RFQ does not authorize charges. Specifications, materials, lead times, pricing and compliance documentation require project-specific confirmation. Read product imagery with its visible concept or sample status.
